title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising on good character and conduct
body_text:
The Prime Minister,  Shri Narendra Modi today shared Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising the importance of good character and conduct:
“ज्ञानवांश्च तथा वाग्मी कर्मस्वपि च निष्ठितः।
एवं युक्तोऽपि न श्रेयान् यदि शीलविवर्जितः॥”
It says that a person who is wise and eloquent and endowed with a good character and conduct is truly a good person.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
ज्ञानवांश्च तथा वाग्मी कर्मस्वपि च निष्ठितः।
एवं युक्तोऽपि न श्रेयान् यदि शीलविवर्जितः॥
ज्ञानवांश्च तथा वाग्मी कर्मस्वपि च निष्ठितः।
